START HERE

Log a problem in 3 simple steps

Give support enough detail to understand the issue quickly. You can still submit a ticket if the Knowledge Base does not solve it.

01

Check for a quick fix

Search the Knowledge Base or ask the AI Coach about the issue. Try only safe, approved troubleshooting steps.

02

Describe what happened

Choose a category and priority. Include the affected device or app, any error message, when it started, who is affected, and what you already tried.

03

Submit and track

Create the ticket, keep its ticket ID, and check the dashboard for status updates. Support may contact you for more details.

Protect your informationNever include passwords, PINs, authentication codes or confidential customer data in a ticket.
CLEAR ROUTING · NO ISSUE LEFT BEHIND

Escalation policy

PulseSync recommends priority and routing from ticket details and historical patterns. The support manager reviews routing, and unresolved issues move to the next level.

01FIRST RESPONSE

Level 1 · Help Desk

Initial assessment, common fixes, account checks and basic device or connectivity troubleshooting.

Within 2 hoursTarget response time
02SPECIALIST SUPPORT

Level 2 · Specialist Support

For issues that Level 1 cannot resolve, or that need deeper system, network, application or hardware investigation.

Within 24 hoursTarget response time
03COLLABORATIVE RESOLUTION

Level 3 · Smart Collaboration Room

Complex or persistent high-impact problems bring senior and relevant technicians together to investigate and agree a resolution.

Within 48 hours**May take longer for complex cases
When is a ticket escalated?

Escalate when the current level cannot resolve the issue, when specialist skills are needed, or when repeated incidents or business impact indicate a more serious problem. Record troubleshooting already attempted and keep the ticket linked to the investigation. The response targets above are from the NovaTech PulseSync SOP; they are response targets, not guaranteed resolution times.
